uncertainty_notes: Fetch obstacle: live phoenixpeptide.com returns Cloudflare-mitigated 403 (header 'cf-mitigated: challenge') to curl; gstack:browse failed in this environment due to Chromium sandboxing-as-root constraint. Per Rule 9 (no anti-bot bypass) and the brief's §11 bounds (do NOT bypass anti-bot), all public-page evidence is captured from archive.org Wayback snapshots dated between Aug 2024 and Nov 2025. Specific uncertain fields and reasons: (1) product_page_anatomy.per_mg_cost — Phoenix prices catalog peptides per fixed micro/milligram quantities (e.g. 100 µg for $120) without dose-per-mg framing; per-mg is computed in skus[] (e.g. $1,200/mg for 066-09) but the headline product-page list_price is the catalog price, not a per-mg figure, so the schema field is not directly applicable. (2) product_page_anatomy.photographic_treatment — saved html2text rendering does not preserve product imagery; product pages reference structure diagrams ('Structure: No results found.') but image style cannot be characterized from text alone. (3) product_page_anatomy.lab_partner_named — no third-party lab partner is named on the public product or about pages; vendor manufactures and tests in-house, but the schema field is therefore not populable with a verbatim partner name. (4) checkout_flow.account_required, guest_checkout_available, fields_collected — the live checkout subdomain (checkout.phoenixpeptide.com) is JS-required ('Our checkout process requires javascript') and the archived cart page captured did not progress past the cart stage; per §11 bounds we did not create an account or submit fake payment info. (5) social_proof.off_site_aggregators — no Trustpilot, no on-site reviews; a wider off-site discovery pass is out of scope for a single-vendor profile. (6) content_footprint.internal_linking_to_products — individual blog posts not fully walked; the news-index page does not show product-link density alone. (7) skus[*].out_of_stock — Phoenix's product pages display Catalog #, Size, and Price but do not surface explicit in-stock/out-of-stock status; the 'Buy Now' / Qty controls suggest direct ordering for catalog peptides but no inventory indicator is rendered. Marked 'uncertain' rather than guessing 'false'. (8) skus catalog has 3000+ items per FAQ; only 5 SKUs captured here as a representative sample to feed Pillar C; full enumeration would require recursive paginated walking which the public catalog UI does not expose via simple URL increments. (9) Tech-stack 'cdn' marked as 'cloudflare' on the basis of the 403 response header 'server: cloudflare' captured during the live curl HEAD attempt (saved in source_homepage.md context); the archive-org snapshot of HTML naturally does not retain origin headers. (10) Inferred fields use [INFERENCE] block per Rule 19: hero_imagery_style (clinical), catalog.sku_count (3000+), catalog.stack_bundle_pages_present (false), product_page_anatomy.coa_present (false), batch_lot_transparency (false), customer_review_module_present (false), tech_stack.marketing_pixels_present (none_observed), tech_stack.chat_widget_present (false), content_footprint.content_cadence, content_footprint.author_bylines_present (false). All inference blocks have ≥2 supporting quotes that grep-match their raw artifacts.
